id: title:Gilbert09:implement the microsoft defender for cloud apps import source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Microsoft Defender Cloud Apps as a warehouse ingestion source, including configuration parameters, credential validation, pagination, resumable ingestion, and unit tests.
review.reason: The chunk includes the implementation and tests for Microsoft Defender Cloud Apps warehouse ingestion. P1.F1 and P1.F2 establish the metadata and configuration. P1.F6 and P1.F7 provide the connector implementation with credential validation, pagination, and resumable ingestion. P1.F8 adds tests. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and tests, but the actual benefit and reliability are not independently verified. No tier assignment requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.
